info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Risk Model Update API facilitates the modification of existing market risk models within a banking environment. This endpoint allows authorized users to update specific attributes of a market risk model identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include risk managers and financial analysts who need to ensure models reflect the latest data and regulatory requirements. By using this API, institutions can maintain accuracy and compliance in their risk assessments.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific market risk model identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request for a successful update.

requestBody.description: Updates the properties of the specified market risk model identified by RES-100045. The request body must conform to the schema defined for updating model properties.
